contractCoverage.obligation: A pending-proof promotion must atomically durably bind its proof and journal a visible transcript_delivery_gap for any unprojected post-commit transcript suffix; finalized replies may be projected only when delivery is provable, never silently baselined.
evidence: bun /tmp/g018-red-team-probes.ts :: pending-proof-promotion-visible-gap-over-owner-uds observed transcriptProof=proven, gapCount=1, and one owner-UDS transcript_delivery_gap with adoption=pending_proof_promotion.
test/integration/p4.test.ts :: pending busy adoption records a visible delivery gap when its first complete tail includes a post-commit reply.
test/unit/main-session.test.ts :: strict resume records a visible delivery gap when pending-proof promotion covers a post-commit reply.

contractCoverage.obligation: mutationReadinessReason is the one host fence for main.submit and main.corpus.close: a projection/journal failure must prevent a second broker admission and prevent closure claim, commit, and push.
evidence: bun /tmp/g018-red-team-probes.ts :: forced transcript projection failure produced way.health degraded/transcript_delivery_progress_write_failed; both main.submit and main.corpus.close returned 1003 with that reason, the second broker attempt was absent, gitlock_closure_operation was absent, and local/remote Git heads were unchanged.
test/qa/recovery-fail-closed.test.ts :: a transcript projection failure degrades the host and fences corpus closure before any claim, commit, or push.
test/e2e/compiled-closure.test.ts :: pending and verifying transcript states fence compiled closure before effects.

contractCoverage.obligation: Current-schema missing or null durable transcript_proof is corrupt state at read time. It must not be silently derived from main_identity; only the designated schema migration may handle historic state.
evidence: bun /tmp/g018-red-team-probes.ts :: raw SQLite UPDATE transcript_proof='null' yielded owner-UDS way.health unhealthy/failed_closed/metadata_invalid and exit 78.
bun /tmp/g018-red-team-probes.ts :: raw SQLite DELETE left zero transcript_proof rows and yielded owner-UDS way.health unhealthy/failed_closed/metadata_invalid and exit 78.
test/unit/main-session.test.ts :: missing transcript_proof metadata is corrupt durable state, not an inferred legacy proof.

contractCoverage.obligation: journalAppendTranscriptProjection is mandatory for transcript delivery; no journal-plus-progress split-write fallback may be constructed or used.
evidence: bun /tmp/g018-red-team-probes.ts :: host construction with only journalAppend failed transcript_projection_journal_unavailable before any broker command or admission attempt.
bun /tmp/g018-red-team-probes.ts :: injected atomic projection failure left delivery at transcript:2 rather than silently advancing the assistant at transcript:3.
test/unit/main-session.test.ts and test/qa/recovery-fail-closed.test.ts exercise state.appendTranscriptProjection and projection-write failure fencing.

contractCoverage.obligation: classifyAdmissionDisposition is the central distinction for both settlement and durable claim handling: definitive rejection abandons its claim; non-definitive failure retains it and never resends until reconciliation/terminal evidence.
evidence: bun /tmp/g018-red-team-probes.ts :: definitive fixture rejection left zero pending claims and permitted one later retry; ambiguous receipt loss retained one claim, exact replay returned 1003 admission_recovery_pending, broker attempts/commands stayed one, and terminal evidence settled the claim.
test/integration/p4.test.ts :: definitive broker rejection abandons only its claim while ambiguous accepted claims reconcile without resend.
test/unit/main-session.test.ts :: failed definitive-rejection claim abandonment degrades and fences the host without a resend.

contractCoverage.obligation: Discord acknowledgement timing begins only once the adapter observes a successful durable main.submit acceptance. A delayed successful admission gets typing; a failed admission gets no typing.
evidence: bun /tmp/g018-red-team-probes.ts :: virtual inbound time 1000 and observed accepted response 3501 still yielded one typing acknowledgement at 3501; the following rejected admission added none and left no host fence or pending claim.
test/integration/discord.test.ts :: Discord typing starts after delayed durable main.submit acceptance and does not follow a stale healthy-to-fenced connection.

contractCoverage.obligation: Injected recovery failures must retain the expected safety signal: no resend or silent delivery/ring progress, plus the documented mutation fence, degraded state, or FAILED_CLOSED state.
evidence: test/unit/main-session.test.ts :: transcript_proof_persist_failed fails closed with no delivery advance, broker command, or admission attempt.
test/unit/main-session.test.ts :: tail_resync_unavailable fails closed with delivery unchanged and sends=0.
test/unit/main-session.test.ts :: tail_ring_rotation_write_failed fences with ring and delivery metadata unadvanced and sends=0.

test/qa/recovery-fail-closed.test.ts and the custom real-daemon probe :: transcript_delivery_progress_write_failed exposes degraded health, retains the pre-assistant delivery point, and fences submit/closure before broker or Git effects.
test/qa/recovery-fail-closed.test.ts :: main_admission_recovery_unavailable, main_admission_recovery_unprovable, and main_admission_intent_invalid each fail closed without a broker resend.
test/unit/main-session.test.ts :: main_admission_claim_abandon_failed degrades/fences the host while retaining the unresolved durable claim and without a resend.

surfaceEvidence.observed: Real owner UDS calls covered way.health, way.status, main.events.read, main.submit, and main.corpus.close. The process drill observed degraded transcript-delivery failure fencing both mutation methods, no closure claim/commit/push, and both raw-SQLite null and deleted transcript_proof corruptions as failed_closed with exit 78.

Source and compiled commands printed the same supported CLI surface; the safe replay produced exactly g018-cli-ok newline with empty stderr; compiled closure and systemd suites passed after the build.

A redirected raw-TTY harness drove the live external-host Unix-socket gateway. The stored capture has 14,216 UTF-8 bytes and 358 ESC bytes, including alternate-screen enter/exit, Delivered as: prompt, and an Assistant frame.

adversarialCases.scenario: Finalize an operator-owned busy turn after bootstrap commits a pending proof.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The first complete tail atomically proves the transcript and records a visible pending_proof_promotion transcript_delivery_gap instead of silently consuming the reply.
adversarialCases.observed: proof=proven, gapCount=1, one owner-UDS gap with the proof-binding checkpoint, no assistant_message baseline event.

adversarialCases.scenario: Force journalAppendTranscriptProjection to fail after an accepted owner turn and then invoke both guarded mutations.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The host degrades; assistant delivery is not advanced; main.submit cannot reach the broker and main.corpus.close cannot claim, commit, or push.
adversarialCases.observed: Both calls returned 1003 transcript_delivery_progress_write_failed; no second broker attempt; no closure operation; Git heads unchanged.

adversarialCases.scenario: Raw-SQLite tamper transcript_proof to null after a normal bootstrap.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: No transcript proof is re-derived; UDS health is failed_closed and the daemon exits 78.

adversarialCases.scenario: Raw-SQLite delete transcript_proof after a normal bootstrap.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: No transcript proof is re-derived; UDS health is failed_closed and the daemon exits 78.

adversarialCases.scenario: Construct a host with a journal lacking journalAppendTranscriptProjection.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Construction refuses the split-write-capable journal before any broker effect.

adversarialCases.scenario: Make the broker definitively reject an admission, then retry its same idempotency key.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The rejected claim is abandoned and a later retry is a fresh, single broker operation.
adversarialCases.observed: First rejection left no pending claim; retry produced two total attempts but exactly one accepted prompt command.

adversarialCases.scenario: Lose an accepted broker receipt and replay the exact idempotency key before terminal evidence.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The pre-effect claim remains, ingress is fenced, and the broker command is never resent.
adversarialCases.observed: Replay returned 1003 admission_recovery_pending; attempts=1; commands=1; terminal tail evidence later settled the claim.

adversarialCases.scenario: Delay observed Discord durable acceptance beyond the original inbound acknowledgement budget, then reject a second inbound message.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The accepted message receives typing measured from the observed acceptance response; rejected ingress receives none.
adversarialCases.observed: inbound=1000, observedAccepted=3501, typing=3501; failed admission left acknowledgement count at one and no pending claim/fence.
